author: Sphrynax
body:
What is this?:
A feature on player's profiles showing how many monuments this player has broken.


Why would it be helpfull?:
Let's say, I was applying for a clan as a rusher, the application format would, one of the things on the format of applying should be, "How many monuments have you broken?", This would help clans accept rushers. Also, #Bragging.


Pros:
Players would now know how many monuments they have broken, maybe a player has set a goal for an amount of monuments per day or something like that.



Cheers! :D
